description: idt2.regione.veneto.it: landslide and ground movement hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by idt2.regione.veneto.it. Coverage: the area served by idt2.regione.veneto.it. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about landslide and ground movement hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Punti indicanti le caratteristiche del dissesto della provincia di Pad; Punti indicanti le caratteristiche del dissesto della provincia di Tre; Punti indicanti le caratteristiche del dissesto della provincia di Ver; Punti indicanti le caratteristiche del dissesto della provincia di Vic. Formats seen: SHP, WMS, WFS, WMTS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
